messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete playable 2D creature adventure game and progressively enhance it with richer overworld graphics, Master League battles, and 3D-styled animated presentation.

## Requirements
- “Pokemon game 2D”
- “Master league”
- “Hd graphics beautiful tree beautiful house and beautiful road”
- “Graphics 3D animation”
- Support for desktop keyboard controls and mobile touch controls.
- Preserve a complete, playable game state.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a single standalone HTML/CSS/Canvas page.
- Used an original creature-adventure theme to avoid direct branding dependency.
- Added original Master League ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Master.
- Used canvas-rendered pseudo-3D shading, depth shadows, rounded forms, and ambient animation rather than introducing a full 3D engine.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full overworld, player movement, collision map, NPC interaction, pond, cottage, roads, and random creature encounters.
- Added keyboard and mobile touch controls.
- Added turn-based creature battles, enemy health, player health, attacks, rewards, and defeat handling.
- Added Master League battles against AUREON with rank points and rank progression.
- Reworked the overworld with HD-style:
  - Detailed grass and trees
  - Terracotta-roof cottage
  - Timber framing
  - Cobblestone roads
  - Flowers, fencing, pond reflections, and premium HUD
- Added 3D-styled battle scene with:
  - Gradient sky
  - Drifted clouds
  - Arena depth
  - Shadows
  - Rounded creature shading
  - Breathing and enemy bobbing animation
- Started the game server at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Saved and inspected screenshots under `screenshots/game.jpg`.

### Active
- None; the latest requested 3D-style battle enhancements are applied.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Validate the latest 3D battle scene and new overworld changes in-browser.
2. Test Master League victory, rank progression, defeat handling, keyboard controls, and touch controls.
3. Make any final visual or gameplay fixes found during testing.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete game implementation and latest graphics changes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/game.jpg`: Latest browser screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: Existing project start script.

## Important Context
- The application is a one-file Canvas implementation with no external asset dependencies.
- Main state variables include `scene`, `partyHP`, `partyMax`, `leaguePoints`, `leagueRank`, `leagueWins`, `leagueBattle`, `wild`, `wildHP`, and `wildMax`.
- Enter initiates interaction or battle actions; Escape cancels battle move selection.
- Mobile controls use on-screen directional buttons plus A/B buttons.
- The latest battle scene uses live `tick`-based pseudo-3D animation.
